Chapter 175: 0172 Made Xue Yi Cry

Since he was back in his hometown, he might as well get his driver's license.

At this time, there were only Subject 1, 2, and 3, with no Subject 4. And there was no specified minimum interval for taking the tests between each subject.

If he were taking the test in Jingcheng, Chen Guiliang couldn't be bothered to wait for the slow scheduling.

Back in a small place, things could be scheduled compactly, and he could get his license in a few days.

"How much is the driving school fee?"

"1800. That doesn't include the test fees. You have to pay separately for each subject's test."

"I'll give you 4000. Can you arrange the tests back-to-back? I already know how to drive, so the shorter the better."

"4000? You really want to take the test? How about I just get you a license directly?"

"I'll take the test myself."

"Then let me make a call and ask."

4000 yuan was enough to buy a license directly; the driving school had never encountered someone who paid so much but insisted on taking the test himself.

The middle-aged woman at the driving school registration desk spoke on the phone with a driving instructor for a while.

After hanging up, the woman said to Chen Guiliang, "Physical exam today. Subject 1 tomorrow morning, Subject 2 tomorrow afternoon. Subject 3 the morning after, and you can get your license in the afternoon."

Including registration and the physical exam, it would all be done in three days…

In the small cities of this era, not many people were learning to drive and getting licenses, and both the tests and the licenses were all paper-based records.

As long as you paid enough, they would make the arrangements for you. In any case, there were no regulations about time intervals.

It wasn't against the rules at all!

After paying, Chen Guiliang received the booklet for Subject 1 and then took a car to the hospital for his physical exam.

On the way, Chen Guiliang called Tao Xue. He felt some things had to be made clear.

Dragging it on was not a solution and would just waste the girl's time.

Chen Guiliang said, "Xue Yi, I'm back in our hometown."

"Really?" Tao Xue was overjoyed.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Are you guys having summer remedial classes to get a head start on the third-year material?"

"Sigh! We had them for a few days, but they were stopped yesterday. I'm still at school," Tao Xue sighed.

"Stopped?"

"I don't know which idiot heard about some document on reducing academic burden and reported the school for holding illegal remedial classes. I think they even called the SZ hotline. Yesterday morning, people from above came to inspect, and in the afternoon, the classes were stopped."

"So you guys will start the third-year textbooks when school officially starts?"

"The teachers told us to study ahead on our own."

"Impressive. I'll come to the school to find you. Let's meet at two in the afternoon at the ice jelly shop."

"Okay, I'll wait for you at the ice jelly shop."

Chen Guiliang quickly finished his physical exam at the hospital, then called his high school teachers.

He first went to the home of Liu Shuying and Gao Zhan to thank the two teachers for their care. Especially his homeroom teacher, Liu Shuying, who had pleaded on his behalf with the principal and the dean of students many times.

Seeing Chen Guiliang, Liu Shuying and Gao Zhan were very happy.

It wasn't that they wanted anything in return; they just felt that this student had not forgotten his roots and still remembered to visit his teachers even after becoming a great tycoon.

After sitting for a while, Chen Guiliang politely declined their offer to stay for a meal and took his leave to visit his Chinese language teacher.

His Chinese teacher, Li Runze, had his wife prepare a lavish lunch in advance, so when Chen Guiliang arrived close to noon, he had no choice but to stay and eat.

The teacher and student chatted about their recent situations. When Chen Guiliang was leaving, Li Runze took out *Those Things of the Ming Dynasty*, "Don't run off. Sign it before you go."

Chen Guiliang not only signed his name but also added a line: Wishing Teacher Li good health and all his wishes to come true.

Li Runze laughed heartily, "Go on, you've completed your task."

In Tao Xue's dorm, only she and Fatty were left; all the others had already gone home.

"You're even putting on makeup. Which lover are you going to see?" Fatty joked.

Tao Xue said, as if showing off, "Senior is back. He asked me to meet him at the ice jelly shop outside school."

"Chen Guiliang?"

"Yeah."

Fatty's mouth fell open, shocked. "You're not really going to date a billionaire, are you?"

"Hee hee." Tao Xue smiled sweetly.

Fatty was incredibly envious. "How romantic, just like a romance novel. The one I rented recently is about a CEO falling in love with a high school girl."

"I'm leaving, bye-bye."

"I wish you success. Go for it!"

"Thanks."

Tao Xue skipped towards the school gate. When she arrived at the ice jelly shop, she found it wasn't open.

The school had canceled the summer remedial classes, so the shops outside had little business. More than half of them were closed today.

Tao Xue walked to the shade of a nearby tree to wait, but in the 39-degree weather, it was very hot even in the shade. It didn't take long for her to be drenched in sweat.

Chen Guiliang came by taxi and saw her standing by the roadside from a distance.

"Driver, please stop under the tree up ahead."

"Alright! Why do you look so familiar?"

"Do I look like Andy Lau?"

"And I look like Jacky Cheung."

"Haha."

Chen Guiliang paid and got out of the car.

Tao Xue waved excitedly, "Senior!"

"Are you silly? Don't you know how to find a cool place with a fan?"

"The ice jelly shop is closed. It was still open yesterday."

"Let's go, find a place to sit."

"Let's go to an internet cafe. A lot of them installed air conditioning last year."

The two of them walked towards the street of internet cafes under the blazing sun.

Tao Xue didn't feel the sweltering heat at all. On the contrary, she found the sunlight today to be very bright and beautiful.

Especially when passing by the roadside trees, the sunlight filtered through the dense canopy of the small-leaf banyan trees, casting dappled spots of light on the side of the road. With the gentle breeze, the leaves swayed softly, and those light spots shifted unpredictably.

How interesting.

This truly was a romantic summer.

Tao Xue said, "The final exam results for the second year are out. I ranked third in my class and forty-second in the entire grade. If I work a bit harder in my third year, I can definitely make it into the top twenty of the grade!"

She was in a regular class, so even being third in her class didn't place her particularly high in the grade-wide ranking.

However, forty-second in the whole school meant getting into a Tier 1 university was no problem.

Chen Guiliang led her to a shady spot and finally couldn't help but say, "I'm dating Bian Guanyue."

Tao Xue whipped her head around to look at him, then squeezed out an ugly smile, forcing a cheerful expression. "That's perfectly normal, I guessed it a long time ago. Senior Bian is so beautiful, and you're both studying in Jingcheng. I really like that song *The Wind Rises*. Did you write it specifically for Senior Bian to sing?"

"Mhm," Chen Guiliang nodded.

Tao Xue rubbed her face with both hands, then rubbed her eyes. Like a face-changing performer in Sichuan opera, when she moved her hands away, her smile became brilliant again. "Let's go to the internet cafe. I haven't played games in a long time. I've been so busy studying hard these past six months."

"Alright." Chen Guiliang couldn't say much more.

The internet cafes on the street were still operating as usual, because no one had reported the remedial classes at the neighboring No. 7 Middle School.

It was the afternoon, so there were very few people in the internet cafe.

Arriving outside one of the cafes, Tao Xue took out a tissue. "Senior, let me wipe your sweat for you. The sweat on your forehead is about to run into your eyes."

"I can do it myself," Chen Guiliang said, reaching for it.

But Tao Xue moved her hand around his and carefully wiped the sweat for him, making Chen Guiliang a little embarrassed.

After wiping his sweat, Tao Xue took out another tissue. "You can wipe mine too."

After saying that, Tao Xue closed her eyes, tilted her head up slightly, and deliberately took half a step forward. Her pretty face, flushed red from the heat, was directly in front of Chen Guiliang at close range.

Chen Guiliang hesitated for a few seconds but ultimately took the tissue and helped wipe the sweat from her forehead and cheeks.

Walking into the internet cafe, it was instantly cool; the air conditioning was turned up high.

Chen Guiliang paid for two computers, and he and Tao Xue sat next to each other to go online.

Tao Xue logged into QQ and left it on, but she didn't chat with anyone. Instead, she turned her head and stared infatuatedly at Chen Guiliang.

She really wanted to cry, but she didn't dare to let it out.

Chen Guiliang was checking his emails. Some company matters were not urgent and didn't require a phone call to report. Using QQ was too brief to explain clearly, so the various departments sent him emails.

Tao Xue glanced over and understood that he was replying to business emails, which made her find Chen Guiliang even more charming.

Especially when he was handling serious matters.

So, she stopped looking at the email content and just stared blankly at Chen Guiliang's side profile.

"Is there something on my face?" Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

Tao Xue shook her head repeatedly. "I was thinking about a math problem, got lost in thought."

Chen Guiliang changed the subject. "I recommend a new website to you. It's called Kaixin Net, it has a lot of fun things."

"Did you start it?" Tao Xue asked.

"Mhm, it just launched," Chen Guiliang said.

"Then I definitely have to check it out."

Tao Xue deliberately pretended not to understand, having Chen Guiliang teach her how to register an account, and then asked what functions the website had.

Seeing that Chen Guiliang wasn't leaning too close, she even scooted her chair over in his direction.

Chen Guiliang said, "Youke recently made a small game called Parking Wars. It's online on Xiaonei Net, Youke Huyou, and Kaixin Net. On Kaixin Net, you can unilaterally follow people. If you both follow each other, you can pull them into your contact list, which is like a friends function. Whether it's stealing crops or fighting for parking spots, you can interact with friends in your contact list."

"This here is for priority follows. When the website updates the feed, the dynamic updates from your priority follows and contacts will be displayed at the top."

Tao Xue asked, "Do you have an account?"

"I'll register one." Chen Guiliang registered directly with his real name and was also going to have the website verify him.

Tao Xue quickly searched for his name. "I followed you, now you follow me back quickly."

After urging Chen Guiliang to follow her back, Tao Xue immediately dragged him into her contact list.

Chen Guiliang pointed to the upper right corner of the page. "There's a list of recommended follows here. Try selecting entertainment celebrities."

After Tao Xue clicked it, a row of verified celebrities instantly appeared.

In the later blog and Weibo wars, you really had to pay money to get celebrities to sign up.

But now, it wasn't necessary.

Because besides Kaixin Net, no other website would proactively invite celebrities.

And what about those celebrities?

They didn't pay much attention to online promotion yet.

Well, that wasn't entirely true.

This year, a few celebrities had already started paying for online shills to create buzz for themselves.

The collaboration between Kaixin Net and the celebrities was mutually beneficial, so the invitations went quite smoothly.

Especially for emerging entertainment companies, whether they were record labels or film companies, they couldn't compete with the established companies offline and were very willing to pull ahead on the internet.

As for those popular online singers, they agreed as soon as they were invited. So far, no one had refused.

There were also internet celebrities, like Sister Furong, Fairy Sister, and so on, who had already registered accounts on Kaixin Net.

Fairy Sister was particularly popular. Netizens all thought she was an amateur, an innocent village girl from the Qiang ethnic group hidden in the great mountains.

In a few months, Sohu.com would hold a poll for the new generation of idols.

Relying on just one set of photos, Fairy Sister would directly beat Li Yuchun and Jerry Yan, and as an amateur, be voted champion by netizens!

Just as Tao Xue was following celebrities and internet personalities, Chen Guiliang glanced at the number of Fairy Sister's followers.

My god, over seventy thousand followers!

Her follower count was higher than those Super Girls and movie stars.

The problem was, from the time she became famous until now, she hadn't sung a single song or acted in a single show, only possessing a set of photos of her carrying a bamboo basket on her back and playing in the water in the countryside.

"Who is this?" Tao Xue had her head buried in her studies and didn't recognize the newly risen internet celebrity.

Chen Guiliang said, "A girl from the Qiang ethnic group. I don't know her name. Netizens all call her Fairy Sister."

Tao Xue said, "She is quite innocent and pure."

Chen Guiliang then looked at the comments under her photos. Besides praising Fairy Sister for being pure and beautiful, many netizens were also asking if her family was facing financial difficulties, and asking how much the betrothal gift would be if she were to marry...

They really thought of Fairy Sister as a village girl, but in reality, she had joined an art troupe years ago.

A professional dancer!

After spending time in the internet cafe until nearly evening, Chen Guiliang took Tao Xue out for dinner and then walked her back to school.

Along the way, Tao Xue didn't say much, unlike how lively she had been in the internet cafe.

"Xue Yi, goodbye." Chen Guiliang waved at the school gate.

"Goodbye, Senior."

Tao Xue was sullen.

Chen Guiliang watched her walk through the school gate before turning to wait for a car by the roadside.

Tao Xue looked back at her senior's retreating figure, and suddenly a wave of grievance and sorrow welled up in her heart.

She ran over quickly, hugged Chen Guiliang tightly from behind, pressed her face against his back, and let out a sob, "Waaa."

Tears streamed down like a spring, and she sobbed uncontrollably.

In a flash, her tears had soaked the back of Chen Guiliang's shirt.

"Sigh!"

Chen Guiliang sighed, turned around, and held her in a silent embrace, gently patting her shoulder to comfort her.

Tao Xue immediately began to cry even harder.

(End of this chapter)
